scripts.kobo-client:snapshot: curl -sSfL https://kf.kobotoolbox.org/api/v2/schema/ -o src/openApi/kobo-client/schema.yaml && echo 'kobo-client schema saved (YAML) to src/openApi/kobo-client/schema.yaml'
scripts.kobo-client:refresh: bun run kobo-client:snapshot && bun run kobo-client:generate
scripts.kuana-data-client:snapshot: curl -sSf http://localhost:8100/doc -o src/openApi/kuana-data-client/schema.json && bun run scripts/format-json.ts src/openApi/kuana-data-client/schema.json
scripts.kuana-data-client:refresh: bun run kuana-data-client:snapshot && bun run kuana-data-client:generate
